stones: Six rivers and three mountain ranges crossed before Zora rises into view

Unalterable 9-locus musical-score street sequence where not a note can be altered or displaced: (1) copper clock -> (2) barber's striped awning -> (3) fountain with nine jets -> (4) astronomer's glass tower -> (5) melon vendor's kiosk -> (6) statue of the hermit and the lion -> (7) Turkish bath -> (8) cafe at the corner -> (9) alley leading to the harbor

Honeycomb memory cells in which the world's most learned men bind famous men, virtues, numbers, vegetable and mineral classifications, dates of battles, constellations, and parts of speech via affinity or contrast
Motionless invariance forced upon Zora so she can be more easily remembered, leading to her languishing, disintegration, disappearance, and being forgotten by the earth
calvino_source.inner_arch: Forced to remain motionless and invariant so the world's most learned men can memorize her point-by-point as an Art-of-Memory armature, Zora languishes, disintegrates, and is forgotten by the earth.
calvino_source.anti_trude_vector: Interactive Renaissance Ars-Memoriae musical staff & honeycomb locus-organ on illuminated vellum and calcined limestone, paired with Royal Plate Guild 16th-century hand-colored copperplate cartography (map.png + map.svg) and fine-art architectural plate (image.png). Walking the strict 1->9 copper-clock-to-harbor score sounds an unalterable WebAudio Dorian chamber motif (refusing out-of-order displacement) and opens honeycomb cells for pinning scholarly memory tokens by affinity or contrast—yet locking cells invariant freezes each stone's living pulse and accelerates masonry/ink weathering until locking all 9 cells dissolves earthly Zora into wind-blown dust, leaving only the luminous mental ghost-score.

zora-scorekeeper.responsibility: Builds the strict 9-locus copper-clock-to-harbor architectural score, WebAudio Dorian chamber synthesizer with displacement refusal, and 9-category honeycomb Ars-Memoriae affinity/contrast binding engine.

zora-entropy-weatherer.responsibility: Builds the motionless-preservation decay physics and procedural Canvas2D renderer (6 rivers, 3 mountain ranges, 9 living-vs-frozen architectural miniatures, fracture networks, wind-borne limestone/gall-ink dust erosion, and surviving silverpoint mental ghost-score).

zora-weaver.responsibility: Integrates layers/nine_loci_score.js, layers/disintegration.js, and an inspectable Map & City Plate drawer/tab (referencing map.png and image.png) into standalone zero-dependency index.html using bespoke custom Ars-Memoriae HTML elements and CSS selectors (J_dom < 0.35), responsive at 1280x800 and 390x844, with full keyboard and prefers-reduced-motion support.

zora-critic.responsibility: Audits Calvino fidelity (all stones, exact 9-locus unalterable order, displacement refusal, affinity/contrast honeycomb binding, memorization-triggers-erasure law), visual plates (map.svg, map.png >=1200px, image.png >=1200px, integrated plate viewer), standalone purity, DOM uniqueness, responsive viewports (1280x800 & 390x844), keyboard & reduced-motion accessibility.

hard_gates.HG-1_fidelity: Exact 9-locus sequence from copper clock to harbor alley enforced as an unalterable score (out-of-sequence skips or displacement attempts visibly and acoustically refused); 6 rivers & 3 mountain ranges present; all 7+ Calvino scholarly memory categories bindable via affinity or contrast; locking all 9 cells freezes Zora invariant and triggers complete earthly disintegration into a mental ghost-score.
hard_gates.HG-2_standalone: Zero external HTTP/HTTPS scripts, stylesheets, fonts, or images; zero cross-directory ../ imports; classic script loading compatible with both file:// and http://.
hard_gates.HG-3_anti_trude_morphology: Bespoke hyphenated HTML custom elements (<zora-codex>, <memoria-stave>, <locus-alveolus>, <token-relic>, etc.) and zora-prefixed CSS selectors guaranteeing structural Jaccard similarity J_dom < 0.35 against all other Atlas cities.
hard_gates.HG-4_ergonomics: Clean layout at 1280x800 desktop and 390x844 mobile without clipping, occlusion, or horizontal overflow; complete keyboard control (1-9, N, B, P, M, R) and prefers-reduced-motion compliance; zero console/page errors.
hard_gates.HG-5_visual_plates: Valid, high-variance Royal Plate Guild map.svg, map.png (>=1200px), and image.png (>=1200px) present in cities/07_zora/ and inspectable via a dedicated Map & City Plate drawer/tab (src='map.png' and src='image.png') inside index.html.
